column1: 30451§petrify§ˈpetrɪfaɪ§v. 使石化；使吓呆；使僵住§Behind the lamassu, more columns sprouted from the ground like ancient trees in a petrified forest, forty feet tall, spindly but still miraculously upright.§在那尊人首牛身像之后，更多柱子从地面拔起，像一片**石化**森林里的古树，高达四十英尺，细长却仍奇迹般地直立着。§§§§petrified adj. 石化的；吓呆的（真题以此形出现）；petrified wood / forest 石化木 / 石化森林；be petrified with fear 吓呆；petrification n. 石化（作用）§petrify ≠ putrefy（腐烂），形近异义§改译文：英文从 Behind the lamassu 开始，删去原译多出的首句「可它依然令人惊叹。」

30452§porous§ˈpɔːrəs§adj. 多孔的；疏松的；（边界、制度）易渗透的§Hayden A. Evans et al. therefore explored aluminum formate (ALF), an inexpensive material with a porous molecular structure that enables gas storage by adsorption, as an alternative storage medium.§因此 Hayden A. Evans 等人研究了甲酸铝（ALF）——一种价格低廉、具有**多孔**分子结构、可借吸附储存气体的材料——把它作为另一种储存介质。§§§§a porous molecular structure 多孔分子结构（真题，靠吸附储气）；porosity n. 孔隙度；permeable adj. 可渗透的（近义，真题亦现）§§改例句：et al. 后漏空格；改译文：英文只说 storage medium，原译「储氢介质」无据

30453§practicality§ˌpræktɪˈkæləti§n. 务实；实用性；可行性§Reagan as a politician is often thought of as being a strict ideological conservative, but this belief obscures the practicality that led to his success—he was willing to compromise and cooperate with people he disagreed with in order to advance his objectives.§作为政治人物，里根常被视为严格的意识形态保守派；但这种看法遮蔽了成就他的那种**务实**——他愿意与自己意见相左的人妥协、合作，以推进自己的目标。§§§§practical adj. 务实的；实用的；practically adv. 几乎；实际上；impracticable adj. 行不通的（真题另现）；pragmatism n. 实用主义（近义）§practicality（务实、可行）≠ practicability（可实施性）§

30454§precede§prɪˈsiːd§v. 先于；在…之前§They then calculated the productivity loss of those groups at 12 weeks and 12 months after the programs began (based on the 28 days preceding each point).§随后他们分别计算了这些小组在项目启动后12周与12个月时的生产力损失（以每个时间点**之前**28天为依据）。§Modern Pueblo tribal nations were preceded by the Ancestral Puebloan civilization, which occupied parts of the southwestern US until approximately 1600 CE.§现代普韦布洛部落民族的**前身**是祖先普韦布洛文明，后者在美国西南部一直存续到约公元 1600 年。§§the 28 days preceding each point 每个时间点之前的 28 天（真题）；be preceded by 前面是…；preceding adj. 在前的；precedent n. 先例；precedence n. 优先（权）；take precedence over 优先于§precede（时间 / 顺序上在前）≠ proceed（继续进行）≠ exceed（超过）；predate 是「（年代上）早于」，真题亦现§改例句2：句末多余的「 .」

30455§preferentially§ˌprefəˈrenʃəli§adv. 优先地；有偏向地§The researchers concluded that whiteflies induce tomato plants to emit chemicals that cause other tomato plants to preferentially defend against microbial infection even when under herbivorous attack.§研究者得出结论：粉虱会诱导番茄植株释放化学物质，使其他番茄植株即便在遭受植食性侵害时，也**优先**防御微生物感染。§§§prefer + -ential + -ly§preferentially defend against 优先防御（真题）；preferential adj. 优先的；优惠的；preference n. 偏好§preferentially（优先地）≠ preferably（最好、更可取地）§

30456§prodigious§prəˈdɪdʒəs§adj. 巨大的；惊人的；非凡的§That his work is enjoyable despite this is a testament to his prodigious imagination-even if people read his books only for the ideas, they will have plenty to consider.§尽管如此，他的作品仍然好看，这正证明了他的想象力何等**惊人**——即便人们读他的书只为那些思想，也大有可咀嚼之处。§§§§prodigious imagination / output / memory 惊人的想象力 / 产量 / 记忆力；prodigy n. 天才（儿童）；奇才（同根）；prodigiously adv. 惊人地§prodigious（量大到惊人，多褒义）≠ prodigal（挥霍的）；与 prestigious（有声望的）形近异义§改例句：删去混入的「Text 2」标签和 Text 2 首句；原书错：prodigal 是「挥霍的」，不是「浪子回头的」（the prodigal son 才指回头的浪子）

30457§prune§pruːn§v. 修剪（树枝）；精简；删减 n. 西梅干；李子干§Arborists assess tree health and perform maintenance such as pruning to promote safety and prevent problems.§树艺师负责评估树木健康状况，并施行**修剪**之类的养护，以提升安全性、防患于未然。§Japanese bonsai artist Masashi Hirao has crafted an approach that transforms the acts of pruning, wiring, and planting into dynamic public performances.§日本盆景艺术家平尾成志打磨出一种手法，把**修剪**、蟠扎、栽种变成充满动感的公开表演。§§pruning n. 修剪（真题以此形出现）；prune a budget / a manuscript 削减预算 / 删改稿件；arborist n. 树艺师；树木养护师（真题同现）§名词 prune（西梅干）与动词「修剪」同形异义；真题取「修枝养护」义§

30458§quota§ˈkwəʊtə§n. 配额；限额；定额；名额§While some philosophers argue that certain types of underrepresentation (of women, for example) are unfair in principle and should be remediated via quotas, there is broad agreement that youth underrepresentation is not inherently unfair since it is universal (all people are underrepresented when young), temporary (underrepresented young people become overrepresented older people), and reflective of a legitimate concern (lack of relevant experience).§尽管一些哲学家认为，某些类型的代表性不足（例如女性）在原则上不公平、应通过**配额**加以纠正，但人们普遍认为，青年群体的代表性不足本身并非不公，因为它是普遍的（人人年轻时都代表性不足）、暂时的（代表性不足的年轻人日后会成为代表性过高的年长者），并且反映了一种合理的关切（缺乏相关经验）。§§§§quotas for underrepresented groups 为代表性不足群体设的名额（真题）；import quota 进口配额§政策语境指为某群体保留的名额或为某商品设定的数量；贸易语境指进口配额，常与 tariff（关税）并列§改译文：漏译三处括号里的说明；原书错：为代表性不足群体设的 quota 是保障名额，不是「数量上限」

30459§quotidian§kwɒˈtɪdiən§adj. 日常的；平凡的；琐碎的；（热病）每日发作的§A category that resists firm delineation, folk art is generally defined by an intimate connection to quotidian life.§民间艺术是一个难以严格界定的类别，通常被定义为与**日常**生活有着密切关联。§§§§quotidian life 日常生活（真题）；quotidian fever 每日热（医学）§书面语，带文学与学术色彩，强调平凡、缺乏戏剧性，常与 sublime、extraordinary 对举§

30460§randomize§ˈrændəmaɪz§v. 使随机化；随机排列§Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Singapore and Samoa, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh.§来自21个社会（包括新加坡与萨摩亚）的研究参与者聆听了**随机排序**的录音：其中18段是取自女性二人自然对话的自发性笑声，另18段是18位不同女性按指令刻意发出的自主性笑声。§§§§randomized recordings 随机排序的录音（真题）；randomized controlled trial 随机对照试验（实验设计核心术语）；random adj. 随机的；randomly adv. 随机地；randomization n. 随机化§§

30461§rectify§ˈrektɪfaɪ§v. 纠正；矫正；改正§As they sat down they turned almost invariably to the person sitting next them, and rectified and continued what they had just said in public.§他们一落座，几乎无一例外地转向坐在自己旁边的人，把刚才当众说过的话再**修正**一番、接着说下去。§§§rect-（直，同 correct）+ -ify§rectify a mistake / a situation 纠正错误 / 扭转局面；rectification n. 校正；整改；correct v. 改正；rectitude n. 正直（同根）§rectify（纠正）≠ ratify（批准、认可），形近异义§原书错：义项里「an situation」应为 a situation

30462§refrigeration§rɪˌfrɪdʒəˈreɪʃn§n. 冷藏；制冷§Before refrigeration, food was preserved using salt, smoking, or ice harvested from frozen lakes.§在**冷藏**技术出现之前，人们用盐腌、烟熏，或从封冻的湖面取冰来保存食物。§They wanted to know whether torsional cooling could be used as a refrigeration method.§他们想知道扭转制冷能否用作一种**制冷**方法。§re- + frig（冷，同 frigid）+ -ation§before refrigeration 在冷藏技术出现之前（真题）；refrigerate v. 冷藏；refrigerator n. 冰箱；refrigerant n. 制冷剂（真题另现）；refrigeration cycle 制冷循环§§改例句2：句末多余的「 .」

30463§regenerate§rɪˈdʒenəreɪt§v. 再生；重新长出；（使）复兴；恢复§Researchers are investigating this feat partly to learn more about humans’ comparatively limited abilities to regenerate, and they’re making exciting progress.§研究者探究这一本领，部分是为了进一步了解人类相对有限的**再生**能力；目前他们正取得令人振奋的进展。§Most animals can regenerate some parts of their bodies, such as skin.§多数动物能**再生**身体的某些部分，例如皮肤。§§regenerate tissue / limbs 再生组织 / 肢体；regeneration n. 再生；复兴；regenerative adj. 再生的；regenerative medicine 再生医学§§

30464§reiteration§riˌɪtəˈreɪʃn§n. 重复；反复；重申§Paintings by the Florida Highwaymen—an informal collective of prolific landscape artists active in Florida during the 1950s and '60s—are recognizable by their reiteration of the same general compositional structures and subjects: moonlit waters and grassy inland rivers, to name two.§佛罗里达公路画家（一个活跃于20世纪五六十年代、松散联合的多产风景画家群体）的画作，因**反复**采用同一套总体构图与母题而一眼可辨：月光下的水面、草木繁茂的内陆河流，仅举两例。§§§re-（再）+ iteration（一次重复）§reiteration of the same structures 反复采用同样的结构（真题）；reiterate v. 重申；iterate v. 迭代；perpetually revisit 不断重返同一母题（真题近义表达）§reiteration 偏「有意识地一再申说」，repetition 中性§

30465§repel§rɪˈpel§v. 排斥；相斥；击退；使反感；防（水）§In their 2022 paper, Christos Dimopoulos et al., having granted that the existence of antigravity—in which antimatter and matter repel rather than attract each other—lacked affirmative experimental support, rightly argued that such antigravity was worth considering on theoretical grounds given that evidence against it was similarly lacking.§在2022年的论文中，Christos Dimopoulos 等人先承认「反重力」（即反物质与物质相互**排斥**而非吸引）缺乏肯定性的实验支持，随后又合理地主张：鉴于反对它的证据同样缺乏，这种反重力在理论层面仍值得考虑。§One end of a soap molecule is hydrophobic (water repelling), and one end is hydrophilic (water attracting).§肥皂分子的一端是疏水的（**排斥**水），另一端是亲水的（吸引水）。§§repel rather than attract 相斥而非相吸（真题，与 attract 同句对举）；repellent adj. 排斥的 n. 驱避剂；water-repellent 防水的；repulsion n. 排斥§repel、compel、expel 同根 pel-（推），常混考§改例句2：句末多一个句点

30466§resplendent§rɪˈsplendənt§adj. 灿烂的；辉煌的；绚丽夺目的§The pine cones were pungent, the pine green was resplendent.§松果气味浓烈，松绿一色**明艳照人**。§§§re-（加强）+ splend（光辉，同 splendid）+ -ent§resplendent in / with 穿着… / 带着…光彩夺目；resplendently adv. 灿烂地；splendid adj. 壮丽的；splendor n. 光辉；radiant adj. 光彩照人的；lustrous adj. 有光泽的（近义）§§

30467§rhetoric§ˈretərɪk§n. 修辞；修辞学；说服的技巧；（贬）花言巧语；空话§Conventional theories of rhetoric hold that presenting information as coming from credentialed experts increases that information's credibility.§传统**修辞学**理论认为，把信息呈现为来自有资质的专家，会提高该信息的可信度。§§§§theories of rhetoric 修辞学理论（真题）；empty rhetoric 空洞的言辞§本指研究如何有效说服的技艺与理论；含贬义时指华而不实或别有用心的话§

30468§ridicule§ˈrɪdɪkjuːl§v. 嘲笑；奚落 n. 嘲弄；笑柄§George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris's having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he—George himself—who had done all the labour worth speaking of.§乔治则反过来**嘲笑**「哈里斯除了吃和睡还干过别的」这个说法，并且铁板钉钉地认定：所有值得一提的活儿都是他——乔治本人——干的。§Philosophy is often ridiculed as an area of study that offers no real benefit in students’ job-hunting effort.§哲学常被**讥讽**为一门对学生求职毫无实际助益的学问。§§ridicule an idea 嘲笑某种说法（真题）；an object of ridicule 笑柄；ridiculous adj. 荒唐可笑的（真题亦现）；ridiculously adv. 荒唐地；mock v. 嘲弄；deride v. 讥讽（近义）§§

30469§saturate§ˈsætʃəreɪt§v. 使饱和；浸透；使充满§Olo is a very saturated blue-green color that can’t be seen with the human eye under natural conditions.§Olo 是一种**饱和**度极高的蓝绿色，人眼在自然条件下是看不到的。§Analyses of Rembrandt's seventeenth-century painting The Night Watch, citing its richly saturated colors and stark contrasts between light and shadow, often characterize the work as an exemplar of the Baroque-era style.§对伦勃朗 17 世纪画作《夜巡》的分析，常援引其浓**饱和**的色彩与光暗之间的强烈反差，将其奉为巴洛克风格的典范。§§be saturated with 充满…；saturated adj. 饱和的；（颜色）饱和度高的（真题取此义）；saturation n. 饱和（度）；saturated fat 饱和脂肪；unsaturated fat 不饱和脂肪§§原书错：「（颜色）饱和度高的」是形容词 saturated 的意思，原书标成动词 saturate 的义项

30470§saunter§ˈsɔːntə(r)§v. 闲逛；漫步；溜达 n. 闲步；溜达§I sauntered along, forgetful of musty papers, of the offices, of my chief …§我一路**闲逛**，忘了那些发霉的纸堆、办公室、我的上司……§§§§saunter along / through 沿着… / 穿过…闲逛；sauntered（过去式，真题以此形出现）；stroll / amble v. 漫步（近义）§§改译文：英文截到 of my chief，删去原译多出的部分

30471§scowl§skaʊl§v. 皱眉；怒视 n. 愁容；怒容§There was a hidden dignity in his scowling as he shuffled about pondering the least ridiculous place for the picture.§他一边踱着步、盘算着把这幅画挂在何处才最不显得荒唐，一边皱着眉；那**皱眉**的样子里藏着一种不为人察的尊严。§§§§scowl at sb 对某人怒目而视；in his scowling 在他皱眉的样子里（真题，scowling 作名词）；frown v. 皱眉；glower v. 怒视（近义）§§

30472§scribe§skraɪb§n. 抄写员；文书；（古犹太教的）经师；律法学者§Compiled in the late 1500s largely through the efforts of Indigenous scribes, Cantares Mexicanos is the most important collection of poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the principal language of the Aztec Empire.§《墨西哥歌谣集》（Cantares Mexicanos）主要靠原住民**抄写者**的努力于十六世纪末汇编而成，是古典纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克帝国的主要语言）最重要的诗歌总集。§§§§Indigenous scribes 原住民抄写者（真题）；manuscript n. 手稿（真题同现）§scribe ≠ scribble（潦草涂写）；与 describe、prescribe、subscribe 同根 scrib-（写），常混考§

30473§scrutinize§ˈskruːtɪnaɪz§v. 仔细审视；细察；详细审查§The most extensive investigations have scrutinized only 10⁶–10⁷ crystalline arrangements, a large absolute number but only a small subset of theoretically possible stable chemical combinations.§迄今最广泛的研究也只**细察**了10⁶–10⁷种晶体排列——绝对数量不小，却只是理论上可能存在的稳定化学组合中的一小部分。§§§scrut-（搜查，同 scrutiny）+ -ize§scrutinize data / arrangements 细察数据 / 排列；scrutiny n. 细察；详细审查；scrutinized（过去分词，真题以此形出现）§scrutinize（细察）≠ scan（扫一眼、浏览）§改例句：上标丢失，106–107 应为 10⁶–10⁷

30474§seminal§ˈsemɪnl§adj. 开创性的；影响深远的；奠基性的§In a seminal 1979 study, Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky presented students and college faculty from Israel, Sweden, and the United States with hypothetical questions involving financial decisions.§在1979年一项**奠基性**研究中，Daniel Kahneman 与 Amos Tversky 向来自以色列、瑞典和美国的学生与大学教师提出了一系列涉及财务决策的假设性问题。§Allen won the award in 2006 for seminal contributions to optimizing compiler techniques.§艾伦因在优化编译器技术方面的**开创性**贡献，于 2006 年获得该奖。§§a seminal study / work 奠基性研究 / 作品；a seminal 1979 study 1979 年的奠基性研究（真题，Kahneman 与 Tversky）；groundbreaking / foundational adj. 开创性的；奠基性的（近义）§seminal（学术上的「奠基性」）≠ seminar（研讨课）≠ semantic（语义的）§改译文：删去英文里没有的「文本1：」；补译文2

30475§sequestration§ˌsiːkweˈstreɪʃn§n. （碳的）封存；固存；隔离；（法律）扣押§Based on data from numerous farm fields, Poeplau and his coauthor concluded that cover crops contribute meaningfully to soil carbon sequestration and, if widely adopted, could help offset agricultural emissions of atmospheric CO₂ and other greenhouse gases.§基于大量农田的数据，Poeplau 及其合著者得出结论：覆盖作物对土壤碳**封存**有实质贡献；若被广泛采用，可帮助抵消农业排放的大气 CO₂ 及其他温室气体。§While these crops are known for increasing biodiversity, Christopher Poeplau and his coauthor argued in a 2015 study that cover crops’ role in supporting soil carbon sequestration deserves more attention.§尽管这些作物以增加生物多样性著称，Christopher Poeplau 与其合作者在 2015 年的研究中主张：覆盖作物在支持土壤碳**固存**方面的作用值得更多关注。§§carbon sequestration 碳封存（真题气候类固定术语）；soil carbon sequestration 土壤碳封存（真题）；sequester v. 封存；隔离；sequestered adj. 与世隔绝的§§

30476§sliver§ˈslɪvə§n. 薄片；细条；一小片；一线§Beneath our lashes, in the sliver of open eyes, stars twinkle in the colors of the winter rainbow.§在我们的睫毛之下、在眼睛睁开的那道**细缝**里，星星闪着冬日虹彩的颜色。§§§§a sliver of light 一线光；the sliver of open eyes 眼睛微睁的一道细缝（真题）§与 slice（切下的一片）相比更细、更不规则；真题写睫毛下微睁的一线视野§
